newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears counter-guarantee for Cogentrix plant.
newsitem.headline: India clears counter-guarantee for Cogentrix plant.

text.p: The Indian cabinet on Thursday approved a counter-guarantee agreement for U.S.-based Cogentrix Inc's Mangalore power plant in the southern state of Karnataka, the government said in a statement.
The 1,000-megawatt power plant costing about 40 billion rupees is a joint venture between Cogentrix and China Light and Power International, the government spokesman said.
The counter-guarantee ensures that the power project is reimbursed in the event the state electricity board failed to pay for its power purchases.
"The Karnataka government should ensure it will make all arrangements for transmission before the plant starts," he said.
The federal Power Ministry would certify that the power tariffs are set at the right level, the spokesman said.
